text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fall—the season for sports! It's finally
here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the academy's first-ever

volunteer-run sports fest! Are you guys
ready to
rumble?

text_block_list.name: Ines & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'm more than ready for today! I
scrubbed
my kendo gear to sparkling
perfection!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait... kendo? I thought this was going
to be a
baseball tourney?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Baseball? I thought a multidisciplinary
martial arts
wood breaking competition
was being held...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, hold up. I thought we were
having a
regular school sports day. You
know, bread speed
eating and all...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! We forgot to settle on a sport!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This is bad! Without a plan, this whole
event's
done for!
DON'T WORRY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We can do everything! We can't let
everyone's
hard work go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Tickezo... But we all brought completely
different
equipment...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No problem! That just means we need to
combine
everything and overcome this
together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
C-combine everything?! What does that
mean
we'll do?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We'll hold the very first ever

baseball-kendo-martial-sports day!
There, it's
settled!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uh... O-okay! So the idea is to make a
new sport
based on everyone's
specialties!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But... how is that meant to be executed?
We must
first construct a set of rules!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's just throw our ideas together! Like,
you've
gotta hit a ball with the kendo
sword and try to
get it in a basket...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and if we write things on the balls,
we could
put a scavenger hunt into the
game, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yup, teamwork will get us out of any
pinch! This is
turning into a fundamental
fall lesson for youthful
spirit!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm! Put like that, your suggestion seems
quite
ingenious... Hmmm!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, everybody—time out! I think we need to work out a real plan from the ground up!
